Assessment of BA.evidence_source: Body Appreciation Scale-2 (BAS-2; Tylka & Wood-Barcalow, 2015a; Marta-Simões et al., 2016): BAS-2 is a 10-item measure designed to assess individuals' acceptance and respect for their bodies, regardless of its appearance (e.g., "I take a positive attitude toward my body" or "I appreciate the different and unique characteristics of my body").

Assessment of BMI.evidence_source: Participants' BMI was calculated using the Quetelet Index from self-reported participants' height and weight (Kg/m2 ).

section_summary.extract_value: This section details the measures used in the study, including demographic information, Body Mass Index (BMI), Figure Rating Scale (FRS), Cognitive Fusion Questionnaire-Body Image (CFQ-BI), Body Appreciation Scale-2 (BAS-2), and Eating Disorder Examination Questionnaire (EDE-Q). Participants self-reported demographic data, weight, and height, with BMI calculated from self-reported values. The BAS-2 was used to assess body appreciation. The section also mentions that Cronbach's alphas for study variables for two groups are presented in Table 1, which was not provided.
